words: The top + bottom rows = Two words that complete the idiom “___ the ___” meaning to get a sense of the mood of a group of people before acting or speaking. Keep in mind: The first word may be at the bottom.
Tall grass that grows in a marsh, or the vibrating part of a woodwind instrument that creates sound
